title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Pooling
author: Graeme Oatley

steps.title: Pool DNA Eluates
steps.instruction: Combine all DNA eluates produced from multiple extractions of the same individual into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the combined volume of DNA eluates does not exceed 1000 µL; use multiple 2 mL tubes if necessary.
Pipette mix 5 times using a wide-bore pipette.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Add Ampure XP or AMPure PB beads to the pooled DNA to facilitate purification.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the beads for 30 seconds.
Immediately add 0.8 X volume of beads to the pooled DNA (e.g., 80 µL beads for 100 µL DNA).

steps.title: Incubate Pooled Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the pooled DNA sample on a rotating mixer at room temperature for 10 minutes, rotating gently at 10 rpm.

steps.title: Isolate Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Separate the beads from the supernatant using centrifugation and a magnetic rack.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the 2 mL microcentrifuge tube in a mini centrifuge for 1–2 seconds.
Transfer the tube to a magnetic rack and allow the beads to pellet.
Gently remove the supernatant and transfer it to another 2 mL microcentrifuge tube to be retained for QC checks.

steps.title: Wash Beads with Ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with freshly prepared 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 70% ethanol to the tube on the magnetic rack, dispensing slowly against the side opposite the beads.
Incubate for 30 seconds.
Aspirate and dispose of the ethanol.
Repeat this wash process for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Remove Residual Ethanol
steps.instruction: Ensure all remaining ethanol is removed from the tube.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the tube in a mini-centrifuge.
Return the tube to the magnetic rack.
Aspirate and dispose of any remaining ethanol.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads using buffer AE.

substeps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and add 400 µL buffer AE (if samples were split across multiple tubes, use volumes that combine to 400 µL, e.g., 200 µL per tube).
Gently mix by pipetting 1–2 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.
Incubate the tube on a heat block at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Recover and Store Pooled DNA
steps.instruction: Collect the final pooled gDNA and store it appropriately.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin down the tube in a mini-centrifuge for 1-2 seconds.
Transfer to the magnetic rack and allow the beads to pellet.
Transfer the eluate to a microcentrifuge tube for storage using a wide-bore pipette tip.
Perform QC as required; dispose of retained supernatant and bead tubes upon successful elution.
Store the pooled gDNA at 4 °C.
